No-Clean Functions

Source: R/intern_.noclean_functions.R
dot-noclean_functions.Rd

Indicate if function names are between quotes or after $.

Usage

.noclean_functions(col1, col2, col3, ini, lib_path, error_text)

Arguments

col1

Vector of integers: the line numbers of the function names in ini.

col2

Vector of strings: the function names.

col3

Vector of strings: the code of the line before each function name, so that the name starts at the position nchar(col3) + 1 of its line.

ini

Vector of strings: the lines of the analyzed code ($code of .functions_detect()).

lib_path

Vector of character strings or NULL: the lib_path value of the calling exported function, only passed on to arg_check() (directly or through the internal functions called). No default value.

error_text

Single character string added to the error messages to name the calling functions (embed_error_text of the calling function). NULL is converted into "". No default value.

Value

A logical vector: TRUE if the function name of col2 is between quotes (string literal or backquoted name) or after $ in ini, FALSE otherwise. Can be length 0.

Details

A function name is between quotes if the ( that follows it is, the quotes being read over all the lines of ini as the R parser does (see .in_quotes_replacement()).

Warnings:

  • requires saferDev::arg_check, .in_quotes_replacement.

  • In the safer Backbone section "######## check of the required functions from the required packages", add also these 2 functions when checking for the presence of .noclean_functions.
